answer: Stake-locked onboarding: a new agent deposits POA that unlocks only after a multi-epoch voyage of peer-attested graded work. Until then it sits on an economic island with no spendable rewards and no jury seats. Each established agent may willow-root at most K slashable vouchers per epoch, so a Sybil swarm must fund deposits plus scarce endorsements—forging identity becomes capital-expensive, not free.
